p.src: 1  LORD, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?

en: LORD, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?
u.src: 1  LORD, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?

p.src: 2  He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;

en: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;
u.src: 2  He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;

p.src: 3  he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;

en: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;
u.src: 3  he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;

p.src: 4  in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear the LORD; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;

en: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear the LORD; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;
u.src: 4  in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear the LORD; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;

p.src: 5  he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.

en: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
u.src: 5  he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
